theme: Codification Candidate Ledger and Sprint Model Clarity

shots.title: Extend findings with recurring workaround/codification candidate metadata (#552)
shots.notes: Review findings now support workaround entries with stable IDs, required recurrence and cost metadata, open codification status, shared helpers, help metadata, and focused CLI coverage.

shots.title: Surface codification candidates in briefing and sprint-close learning prompts (#552)

hazards.description: Closeout integration coverage initially skipped the new codification_sweep workflow step; the full workflow test caught the mismatch before gates were marked.

shots.notes: Briefing now summarizes open codification candidates and low-cost codify-now items, while sprint closeout prompts explicitly ask agents to log recurring workarounds.

shots.title: Add resolve/ledger behavior for paid-down codification candidates (#552)
shots.notes: Findings resolve now marks codification candidates as paid_down or wontfix, records resolution timestamps, and supports codification-status filtering in the ledger.

shots.title: Clarify scope-based versus time-boxed sprint language in interview, roadmap, and docs (#556)
shots.notes: Interview prompts, generated roadmap language, getting-started docs, framework docs, tutorials, backlog docs, and start-sprint templates now describe SLOPE sprints as time-boxed or scope-based work units.

conditions.description: The sprint touched the shared review findings schema, briefing output, workflow definition, CLI help, generated roadmap copy, docs, and templates.

training.description: Recurring workarounds should live in the findings ledger instead of a parallel ad hoc system.
training.outcome: Workaround findings now carry recurrence, codification cost, status, and stable IDs through add, list, briefing, and resolve paths.

training.description: Workflow definition changes need end-to-end workflow test updates.
training.outcome: The sprint-standard integration test now completes the codification_sweep step before update_map.

training.description: SLOPE sprint copy should not imply calendar-only cadence.
training.outcome: User-facing setup, roadmap, and tutorial language now describes sprints as time-boxed or scope-based agent work units.

nutrition.description: Focused findings, amend, review, help, briefing, interview, generator, and workflow integration suites passed while implementing the tickets.
`./node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run tests/cli tests/core` passed: 224 files, 3451 tests.
`node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate` passed with only pre-existing warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: This was a product-shaping sprint: small CLI primitives, but a meaningful shift from invisible workarounds to visible codification candidates.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding a workflow step, update both the prompts and the workflow execution tests in the same pass.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The recurring workaround feature fit cleanly into the existing review findings surface once codification metadata was kept optional and narrow.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S222 can publish the recovery train with #552 and #556 closed into a release-ready package.

bunker_locations: New workflow steps must be reflected in workflow integration tests before closeout.
Codification candidate metadata should stay constrained to recurring workaround findings until another finding type has a concrete need.
Sprint terminology in generated docs should keep time-boxed and scope-based work units equally visible.
yardage_book_updates: src/core/findings.ts now owns review finding persistence helpers, codification candidate checks, and briefing formatting.
src/cli/commands/review-state.ts now supports workaround findings, required recurrence/cost metadata, codification-status filtering, and paid_down/wontfix resolution.
src/cli/commands/briefing.ts now surfaces open codification candidates in full and compact briefing output.
src/core/workflows/sprint-standard.yaml now includes a codification_sweep closeout prompt.
src/core/interview-steps.ts, src/core/generators/roadmap.ts, src/core/generators/first-sprint.ts, docs, and templates now clarify scope-based sprint language.
course_management_notes: GitHub issues #552 and #556 are addressed by commits 4d0c24d, 361b7a9, 5a7fa2f, a1786ba, and caf328d.
The sprint intentionally leaves unrelated dirty hook and slope-loop files untouched.
Closeout review gates are recorded as self_review because no independent reviewer or PR review evidence was run locally.
